description: This PHP source file manages the editing of blocked devices within a parental control web interface. It includes server-side logic to retrieve device details, process user inputs, and generate a form for editing device properties such as name, MAC address, block status, and schedule. It also contains embedded JavaScript for client-side validation and interactions.

methods.name: getStr
methods.description: Fetches a string value associated with a nested key from configuration or language settings.

methods.name: KeyExtGet
methods.description: Retrieves device attribute values based on provided base path and parameters.

methods.name: days_time_conversion_get
methods.description: Converts scheduled device block times to user-readable format.
